_header.labelledBy: Claude (Sonnet 5.5, tdd-guide agent) for the Hirelane Slice 3 pasted-job lane
_header.method: Synthetic pasted job posts in Naukri-card, LinkedIn, WhatsApp-forward and drive-notice styles, assembled from fixed title/company/city slots and the criteria phrasings of drive-criteria.labelled.jsonl. Labels (title, company, criteria keys, fresher, source, city) are the slot values, written by the generator BEFORE parsePastedJob existed; the corpus was regenerated once after the first parser run to fix generator flaws (the drive_a headline 'for 2026 Batch' was unlabelled or conflicted with the body batch, so it now appears only when no batch criterion exists and carries the yr|2026 label; Experience and Entry level lines were added to wa_c, drive_c and linkedin_b because they had no fresher cue at all). Labels were not otherwise changed to match parser output. Fictional companies only; URLs use example.test hosts except naukri.com and linkedin.com path shapes. criteria key format matches drive-criteria.labelled.jsonl.
